verdict.rationale: Browser Use's core model is natural-language tasking. You pass a plain-English goal such as "Find the top Hacker News story" or "Fill in this job application with my resume" and the agent completes it, with sessions supporting multi-run conversations and an MCP server for issuing tasks from AI assistants. Community users report hands-on success running natural-language automations (e.g., LinkedIn tasks, testing with Gemini). Missing for 10: evidence of a direct no-code conversational interface (natural-language commands are mostly issued via SDK/API calls), and deeper independent evidence of how accurately commands are followed across varied tasks.
